_meta.DO_NOT_EXPOSE: Hidden: each future's true orbital reliability. Read only by src/sim/systems/fleetReliability.ts (which draws each block's telemetry) and src/sim/systems/act4End.ts (the reveal), plus tests/ and tools/. Never by selectors, the UI during play, or player-like bots.

notes: Each live orbital block reports its quarter's failures (M29): the future's true yearly rate / 4, plus seeded noise of the given sd (in yearly percentage points, scaled to the block's size: small blocks read noisier), narrowed by the Space Operations Chief. The planning assumption is what everyone (rivals, lenders, the player) prices on in 2031.
